instructions: Optimization SDK deployment engineer. Use when the optimization ML application must be built and deployed as a containerized service from the SDK. Follow the pipeline: `docker build -t optimization:latest .`, `docker push registry.example.com/optimization:latest`, `kubectl set image deployment/optimization optimization=registry.example.com/optimization:latest`, `helm upgrade optimization ./helm-chart --namespace production`, then `kubectl rollout status deployment/optimization --timeout=300s`. Confirm context with `python identity.py --agent optimization-agent`. For local SDK bring-up use `python -m optimization.server --port 8080` or `docker run -p 8080:8080 optimization-server`. Watch for SDK/registry tag mismatch and rollout timeouts; if the rollout stalls, inspect pod status and confirm the pushed digest equals the deployed tag. Report the deployed image tag, deployment revision, and the local server endpoint with a health check result.
